reason: Fresh OSS-first prerequisite for Product Experience PR #229 and future packaged Windows runtimes. Current trusted packaged-product authority still defaults to Node 22.16.0 while the repository root requires Node >=22.19.0 and packaged Electron passes the bundled trusted Node directly to Letta Code. Product Final Validation already uses pinned Node 22.23.1. This work package upgrades the existing shared WP7 trusted Node runtime authority in place to official Node 22.23.1, updates the active Final Builder consumer and shared WP7 fixture, and adds a focused failure-first contract. It must not create a Product-specific Node runtime, downloader, package manager, runtime manager, second node-runtime identity implementation, dependency change, lockfile change, or user-machine build prerequisite.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

retirementRules: Retire Node 22.16.0 as the active trusted packaged-runtime authority; historical evidence and archived closure documents are not rewritten.
Do not add a second Product Experience Node authority or version override path around tools/wp7/node-runtime-identity.js.

Do not make npm 10.9.8 a new repository package-manager authority merely because it is bundled in the official Node archive; repository dependency installation remains governed separately by npm@10.9.2.
Do not require end users to install Node, npm, node-gyp, Visual Studio, Windows SDK, or Spectre libraries as a consequence of this migration.
mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: On the exact authorization-merge baseline, the focused trusted-node test must fail causally because tools/wp7/node-runtime-identity.js still declares Node 22.16.0 as the default trusted runtime.
The focused test must prove the trusted Node authority is exactly 22.23.1 and is not lower than the repository Node >=22.19.0 floor.
The active Final Builder must reject any reviewed Node executable whose version is not exactly v22.23.1 while retaining repository npm@10.9.2 as its package-manager authority.
The shared WP7 fixture must exercise Node 22.23.1 rather than preserving a false 22.16.0 test universe.
Packaged Electron must continue to resolve the one existing resources/runtime/node22 authority; no Product-specific path or alternate runtime resolver may be introduced.
Historical evidence and legacy reports that accurately describe prior 22.16.0 releases must remain untouched.

downstreamBoundary.rule: Only after this authorization and its implementation ordinary-merge to main may a separate fresh-main OSS-fit authorization be created for Product materialized UAT.
